evidence.use: The official concordance and local QAC confirm 24 nominal occurrences in 23 verses: thirteen singular fahishah, four plural fawahish, and seven fahsha. The installed Hafs text of 29:28 has emphatic declarative innakum la-tatuna.
Primary Maqayis verifies the root definition and the qualification concerning objectionable excess.
Primary Lisan, Taj, and Lane verify the Arabic forms, miserliness usage, and the distinction between plural fuhasha and nominal fahsha.
The early Muallaqat commentary verifies Tarafah’s witness and its setting of wealth and miserliness. The Arabic poem was preserved.
Primary Tabari documents the contextual connection with giving and wrongful withholding, without making the words exclusive lexical synonyms.
Primary Qurtubi records differing analyses of hamm and lawla; the supplied conditional translation was identified as one analysis.
